```{r packages, include=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, scales, pander)
```

# Loan parameters

```{r parameters, echo=FALSE}
loan_amount <- 345000  # principal
annual_rate <- 0.07125    # 6% annual interest
years <- 30            # loan term
daily_rate <- annual_rate / 365
params <- list(
  "Loan Amount" = scales::dollar(loan_amount),
  "Annual Interest Rate" = annual_rate,
  "Loan Term (Years)" = years,
  "Daily Interest Rate" = daily_rate
)

extra_monthly_payment <- 2800
# Use pander to print the list as a table
pander::pander(params, caption = "Loan Parameters")
```

# Monthly payment calculation

```{r montlycalc, echo=FALSE}
monthly_rate <- annual_rate / 12
n_months <- years * 12
monthly_payment <- loan_amount * (monthly_rate * (1 + monthly_rate)^n_months) / ((1 + monthly_rate)^n_months - 1)

calc_steps <- data.frame(
  Step = c(
    "Monthly Interest Rate",
    "Number of Monthly Payments",
    "Monthly Payment"
  ),
  Formula = c(
    "annual_rate / 12",
    "years * 12",
    "loan_amount * [monthly_rate * (1 + monthly_rate)^n_months] / [(1 + monthly_rate)^n_months - 1]"
  ),
  Result = c(
    round(monthly_rate, 6),
    n_months,
    round(monthly_payment, 2)
  )
)

# Display with pander
pander::pander(calc_steps, caption = "Monthly Mortgage Payment Calculation Steps")
```

# Bi-weekly payment: half of monthly payment

```{r include = FALSE}
n_biweeks <- years * 26
biweekly_rate <- annual_rate / 26
biweekly_payment <- loan_amount * (biweekly_rate * (1 + biweekly_rate)^n_biweeks) / ((1 + biweekly_rate)^n_biweeks - 1)
```

$$\text{Bi-weekly Payment} = \frac{\text{Monthy Payment}}{2}$$

```{r echo=FALSE}
pander::pander(paste0('<h3 style="text-align:center;"> ',scales::dollar(biweekly_payment)," bi-weekly</h3>"))
```

### Bi-weekly simulation ###

```{r biweek_sim}
n_biweeks <- 0
balance_biweekly <- loan_amount
total_paid_biweekly <- 0
total_interest_biweekly <- 0



while(balance_biweekly > 0) {
  interest <- 0
  for (i in 1:14) {
    daily_interest <- balance_biweekly * daily_rate
    interest <- interest + daily_interest
    balance_biweekly <- balance_biweekly + daily_interest
  }
  
  # Optional: Add extra payments every month
  if (n_biweeks %% 2 == 0) {
    # every ~month (every 2 bi-weekly periods), apply extra payment
    payment <- min(biweekly_payment + extra_monthly_payment, balance_biweekly)
  } else {
    payment <- min(biweekly_payment, balance_biweekly)
  }
  
  balance_biweekly <- balance_biweekly - payment
  total_paid_biweekly <- total_paid_biweekly + payment
  total_interest_biweekly <- total_interest_biweekly + interest
  n_biweeks <- n_biweeks + 1
}

```


### Monthly simulation ###

```{r monthly_sim}
n_months_paid <- 0
balance_monthly <- loan_amount
total_paid_monthly <- 0
total_interest_monthly <- 0

while(balance_monthly > 0) {
  days_in_month <- 30.44
  interest <- 0
  for (i in 1:round(days_in_month)) {
    daily_interest <- balance_monthly * daily_rate
    interest <- interest + daily_interest
    balance_monthly <- balance_monthly + daily_interest
  }
  payment <- min(monthly_payment, balance_monthly)
  balance_monthly <- balance_monthly - payment
  total_paid_monthly <- total_paid_monthly + payment
  total_interest_monthly <- total_interest_monthly + interest
  n_months_paid <- n_months_paid + 1
}
```


### Extra monthly payment simulation ```r pander::pander(scales::dollar(extra_monthly_payment))```

```{r extra_monthly_sim}
n_extra_months <- 0
balance_extra <- loan_amount
total_paid_extra <- 0
total_interest_extra <- 0

while(balance_extra > 0) {
  days_in_month <- 30.44
  interest <- 0
  for (i in 1:round(days_in_month)) {
    daily_interest <- balance_extra * daily_rate
    interest <- interest + daily_interest
    balance_extra <- balance_extra + daily_interest
  }
  payment <- min(extra_monthly_payment, balance_extra)
  balance_extra <- balance_extra - payment
  total_paid_extra <- total_paid_extra + payment
  total_interest_extra <- total_interest_extra + interest
  n_extra_months <- n_extra_months + 1
}
```

### Summary Output ###

```{r cat_summary, include=FALSE}
cat("===== Monthly Payments (Standard) =====\n")
cat(" - Payment:         $", round(monthly_payment, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Total Paid:      $", round(total_paid_monthly, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Total Interest:  $", round(total_interest_monthly, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Payoff Time:     ", n_months_paid, " months (", round(n_months_paid / 12, 2), " years)\n\n")

cat("===== Bi-Weekly Payments =====\n")
cat(" - Payment:         $", round(biweekly_payment, 2), " every 2 weeks\n")
cat(" - Total Paid:      $", round(total_paid_biweekly, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Total Interest:  $", round(total_interest_biweekly, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Payoff Time:     ", n_biweeks * 14 / 30.44, " months (", round(n_biweeks * 14 / 365, 2), " years)\n\n")

cat("===== Monthly Payments ($2800) =====\n")
cat(" - Payment:         $", extra_monthly_payment, "\n")
cat(" - Total Paid:      $", round(total_paid_extra, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Total Interest:  $", round(total_interest_extra, 2), "\n")
cat(" - Payoff Time:     ", n_extra_months, " months (", round(n_extra_months / 12, 2), " years)\n")
```

```{r pander_summary, echo=FALSE}
# Monthly Payments (Standard)
monthly_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Payment", "Total Paid", "Total Interest", "Payoff Time"),
  Value = c(
    scales::dollar(monthly_payment),
    scales::dollar(total_paid_monthly),
    scales::dollar(total_interest_monthly),
    sprintf("%d months (%.2f years)", n_months_paid, n_months_paid / 12)
  )
)
pander(monthly_summary, caption = "Monthly Payments (Standard)")

# Bi-Weekly Payments
biweekly_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Payment", "Total Paid", "Total Interest", "Payoff Time"),
  Value = c(
    paste0(scales::dollar(biweekly_payment)," every 2 weeks"),
    scales::dollar(total_paid_biweekly),
    scales::dollar(total_interest_biweekly),
    sprintf("%.2f months (%.2f years)", n_biweeks * 14 / 30.44, n_biweeks * 14 / 365)
  )
)
pander(biweekly_summary, caption = "Bi-Weekly Payments")

# Monthly with Extra Payment
extra_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Payment", "Total Paid", "Total Interest", "Payoff Time"),
  Value = c(
    scales::dollar(extra_monthly_payment),
    scales::dollar(total_paid_extra),
    scales::dollar(total_interest_extra),
    sprintf("%d months (%.2f years)", n_extra_months, n_extra_months / 12)
  )
)
pander(extra_summary, caption = paste0("Monthly Payments (",scales::dollar(extra_monthly_payment),")"))
```

### Visualization ###

```{r viz1, echo=FALSE}
df <- data.frame(
  Plan = c(paste0("Monthly (",scales::dollar(monthly_payment),")"), paste0("Bi-Weekly(",scales::dollar(biweekly_payment),")"), paste0(scales::dollar(extra_monthly_payment)," Monthly")),
  TotalPaid = c(total_paid_monthly, total_paid_biweekly, total_paid_extra),
  InterestPaid = c(total_interest_monthly, total_interest_biweekly, total_interest_extra)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Plan, y = TotalPaid, fill = Plan)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = dollar(TotalPaid)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Total Mortgage Cost: Monthly vs Bi-Weekly vs $2800",
       y = "Total Amount Paid", x = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  theme_minimal()
```
